newsitem.title: CANADA: Noranda Heath Steele closed up to 2 weeks.
newsitem.headline: Noranda Heath Steele closed up to 2 weeks.

text.p: Noranda Inc said on Tuesday it will keep its Heath Steele zinc and lead mines closed for up to two more weeks to carry out an independent safety assessment of its operations.

Two accidents have occurred at the mine in the past month. On November 4, one man was killed and another is still recovering in hospital after a blast in the mine. Earlier this week, four miners were hospitalized after coming into contact with gases in the mine.
Outside experts will start their assessment of the mine on Wednesday, said Derek Pannell, president of Noranda's New Brunswick mining operations.
"I expect that the assessment wilil take 10 days or so," Pannell said in a statement. "This assessment will assist us in restoring confidence in our ability to reopen and operate the mine safely."
The mine produces 2,700 tonnes of ore a day. ((Reuters Toronto Bureau 416 941-8100))
